item.title: Her Shadow
item.description: Her shadow follows, as shadows do, three steps behind, opposing the light. She sees it but will not fall into it.

item.title: Green Snake
item.description: She offers a green snake, ancient symbol of healing. I take what she offers.

item.title: Not Every Man
item.description: Not every man needs a home, and not every home needs a woman.

item.title: Can't Be Swayed

item.title: Secret
item.description: Somewhere shimmers a hidden light, the source of love, the truth of life, the holy ground from which hope grows, and this is the secret the poet knows.

item.title: Two Icebergs

item.title: Over and Over
item.description: The same things must be said over and over because we are always forgetting, or maybe we never quite grasp what they mean.

item.title: No Shortcuts
item.description: There are no shortcuts on the road to ourselves. It takes time.

item.title: My body hurts
item.description: My body hurts but I must be imagining it. The man on TV says it's fine, and he's never lied to me before.
